explanation: A king of Judah who ruled righteously and feared God. He was the son of King Uzziah and father of King Ahaz.
Another name for God, the almighty Creator who, according to Genesis, created heaven, earth, and all life.
A holy place where people worshiped God and offered gifts. In Jerusalem stood the first temple built by King Solomon.
A hill or plateau where people in ancient times performed religious ceremonies and worshiped gods, including idolatry.
A military structure or building designed to protect against enemy attacks.
An ancient people who lived east of the Jordan River. They were often in conflict with the people of Israel.
An armed conflict between two or more parties, often involving countries, groups, or nations.
